inlines.v: STOLE, preterit tense of steal. STOLE, noun 1. A long vest or robe; a garment worn by the priests of some denominations when they officiate. It is a broad strip of cloth reaching from the neck to the feet. 2. [Latin] A sucker; a shoot from the root of a plant, by which some plants may be propagated; written also stool.
